name: Docebo
summary: Docebo sells two quote-only plans, Elevate and Enterprise, priced on active learner usage under monthly, yearly or registered active user models. Its pre-built dashboards cover enrollments, completions, certifications and learning plans, and reports can be emailed as CSV on a daily, weekly or monthly schedule.

facts.text: The pricing page states that pricing is based on active learner usage, not simply the number of accounts, and offers monthly active user, yearly active user and registered active user models.
The pricing page says commercial terms are tailored to each organization and documented in the agreement; no dollar prices or minimums are shown.
Docebo says it maintains an ISO 27001, 27017, 27018 and 27701 certified information security management system and releases a SOC 2 Type II report each year.
The compliance page says audit reports are available under NDA through the Docebo trust center.
The home page names Microsoft Teams, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, Zoom and Slack among its integrations.

plans.name: Elevate
plans.notes: Core learning management; price by request

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Adds advanced analytics, extended enterprise domains, sandboxes and a branded mobile app; price by request

hiddenCosts: Add-ons such as Advanced Analytics, Roleplay and Content are listed without prices, and roleplay is paid by annual simulation volume.
Additional users beyond the contract are handled according to the agreement.

contract.cancellation: Term length, billing cadence, renewal and price protection are set with a sales representative.
